offering_description.value: Owns and operates Spanish-language radio stations in major US Hispanic markets, selling audio advertising time and digital audio content to brands and their agencies, and reaching Hispanic listeners through broadcast, streaming and live events.

primary_products.value: radio programming; digital audio streaming; live events

primary_services.value: advertising sales; digital marketing; event production and promotion

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, advertising agencies, consumer brands, event sponsors; B2C: Hispanic radio and streaming listeners who consume the programming

end_markets.value: advertising; media and entertainment; consumer goods; automotive; retail

revenue_model.value: advertising: audio and digital advertising time sold to brands and agencies; other: live event ticketing, sponsorships and promotional partnerships

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells airtime and digital audience reach to advertisers, sold to brands and agencies; asset operator: owns and runs radio stations, licenses and broadcast facilities used to reach listeners

geography_served.value: US national: Hispanic radio markets including New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Chicago and San Francisco

specialization.value: niche specialist: Spanish-language radio broadcasting and related digital audio and events

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling advertising to national and local clients; online: streaming apps and station websites delivering audio content to listeners; agents / brokers: advertising agencies and media buyers placing campaigns on its stations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: radio broadcast licenses required from the Federal Communications Commission, plus FCC ownership and content rules

notes: The current station portfolio and market list may have changed, so the named markets are a best estimate.
